summary.headline: Sun in the Planetary Terms
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Mars in Venus’s and Mercury’s terms, including mixed fortunes, office, enemies, wealth, domestic anger, and relief when a fortune aspects Mars. Chapter 23 then interprets the Sun in the terms of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus, covering rank, wealth, piety, travel, illness, marriage, and good works.
